[LIMP.2.1.6] **No namespace packages.** `import units` is a
compile error if `units.ds` does not exist, even when
`units/si.ds` does. There is no implicit "library is the
directory" rule. Pure grouping prefixes are expressible by
authoring an empty (or re-export-only) `units.ds` if the
author actually needs `import units` to mean something; the
common case is to import the specific leaf library directly.
